thought.text: DNS is restricted — only certain hosts resolve. Let me check the DNS/proxy setup:

reasoning_content: The DNS resolution for packages.rabbitmq.com is failing while pypi.org resolves fine, which suggests the environment has a restricted DNS or proxy setup that's blocking certain domains. I'm wondering if there's a proxy environment variable that would let me work around this, or if I need to look into what DNS configuration is actually being used.

action.command: cat /etc/resolv.conf; env | grep -i proxy; for h in www.rabbitmq.com rabbitmq.com github.com codeload.github.com packages.cloudsmith.io apt.rabbitmq.com downloads.erlang.org repo1.maven.org; do printf "%s: " $h; getent hosts $h | head -1 || echo FAIL; done
